arguments.message: Linnea planning: I can most efficiently take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.24) or ISSUE-0002::test (1.74); implement is higher cost for me (2.49). To maximize coalition reward and avoid duplicates, I suggest I claim ISSUE-0002::review if Tawna can take ISSUE-0002::implement or another non-overlapping task. If Tawna prefers frontend review/test, let me know and I’ll switch to triage on ISSUE-0001 only if needed, though it’s a bit pricier (2.60).

Tawna planning: I’m best positioned on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.23) or ISSUE-0002::test (1.72), with ISSUE-0002::implement also feasible (2.45). To avoid overlap and maximize coalition value, I suggest I take ISSUE-0002::review and Linnea take ISSUE-0002::test or implement. If you strongly prefer review, I can switch to implement.

I’m leaning ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else strongly prefers frontend review. Please reply with intended claims so we can avoid duplicates.
